IT services firm Coforge
has joined the SpaceX ​Super Intelligence
Partner Network to help ‌companies integrate the Grok artificial
intelligence ​portfolio into their operations, ⁠it said on Friday.
* Coforge will participate as a "Transformation ‌Partner", developing industry-specific Grok solutions and deploying them within clients' ‌existing systems and workflows, ‌the ⁠company said
* It did ⁠not disclose financial details of the partnership

* The deployments will be handled through ​Momentuum Blue,
Coforge's ‌customer-facing engineering unit, which embeds teams
of engineers and AI agents within client organisations and links
their ‌work to agreed business targets
* ​Coforge said the partnership would draw on its ⁠AI-led engineering and modernisation services, including its Nuuron enterprise AI platform

* "From software modernization ‌and customer service to
enterprise applications, we bring the industry context,
engineering expertise and adoption capabilities to turn Grok's
technology into solutions," said Anup Nair, chief ‌AI commercial
officer, Coforge

* The Grok portfolio includes ​tools for chat, research,
analysis, software development, conversational services, ⁠and
image and video generation

title: Coforge joins SpaceX partner network to deploy Grok AI tools for enterprises
